original_wording: (a) rank association + relative concordance; (b) absolute agreement; (c) predictive performance
current_proposed_position: Adopt (a) rank association only. Remove relative concordance. No absolute agreement, calibration, or predictive performance.
supporting_evidence: 4L.13 association/concordance review; 4L.14 protocol §11; independent review F-04/F-11; addendum F-01/F-04. RFU and biovolume/biomass are different quantities and scales; no conversion exists.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether the team wants any directional-change statistic. It is not required for the primary question and would reintroduce an under-defined secondary analysis.
specific_reviewers: Independent scientific reviewer + independent statistical reviewer
evidence_that_would_resolve: Signed scientific and statistical acceptance of rank association only.
student_explanation: This decides that the study asks whether two measurements tend to rise and fall together in rank order — not whether the sensor is calibrated, agrees in absolute units, or can predict biomass.

original_wording: (a) supplied biomass; (b) derive biovolume from cell volume × density; (c) exclude Buffalo Pound
current_proposed_position: Use supplied Biomass_mg_m3 conditionally. Do not derive a new biovolume endpoint. Keep P3/P4 exploratory until the data custodian verifies the exact derivation and field provenance.
supporting_evidence: Painter et al. 2022 methods (microscopy, species identification, cell-volume geometry, wet-weight biomass) verified in 4L.14 independent review; local arithmetic consistent with Cell_Volume × Cell_Density × 10^-6 under 1 g/cm3; addendum F-02/F-09. Müggelsee metadata documents 1 g/cm3 but does not verify the Buffalo Pound field.
remaining_uncertainty: Exact density/rounding chain; whether local Biomass_mg_m3 exactly matches the paper method; replicate-row semantics; detection limits.
review_readiness: Conditional — custodian evidence and D-08 required
evidence_that_would_resolve: Written data-custodian confirmation of the biomass field derivation, density assumption, and field mapping; resolution of duplicate-row semantics. If unavailable, P3/P4 remain exploratory or Buffalo Pound is excluded from primary analysis.
student_explanation: Can we use the supplied biomass number? Only if the data owner confirms how it was produced and how duplicate rows were handled. Until then, Buffalo Pound stays exploratory.

original_wording: (a) 0.5 m vs 0–8 m, no correction; (b) attempt a depth correction; (c) exclude Mendota
current_proposed_position: Adopt (a): no depth correction; frame as a depth-mismatched case study; no whole-column or depth-effect claim. Addendum proposes including all eligible dates with station status reported and station-specific sensitivities.
supporting_evidence: 4L.9 sensor audit; 4L.10 independent challenge; addendum F-06. Sensors at 0.5 m; biology is a 0–8 m tube composite; ~106 m offset; station blank for 371/402 dates.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether station-coded and blank dates represent the same location/composition; the design cannot separate depth from other differences.
review_readiness: Ready now — document review, including proposed station rule
evidence_that_would_resolve: Scientific and data-custodian acceptance of the no-correction framing and the station-status/sensitivity rule; source documentation of station semantics.
student_explanation: The sensor sits at 0.5 m, while the microscope sample is a 0–8 m mix. We will not pretend these are the same depth or claim a depth effect.

current_proposed_position: Adopt (a): separate eras; never concatenate; 2019 transition analysed separately by instrument; no conversion.
supporting_evidence: 4L.9 paired 2019 medians (Turner chlorophyll 1,354.74 vs YSI 0.39; phycocyanin 802.01 vs 0.59); EML documents significant magnitude differences; addendum D-04. Müggelsee also has YSI/EXO2 instrument changes, reinforcing era separation.
remaining_uncertainty: None for separation. YSI sample size is small and secondary.
evidence_that_would_resolve: Data-custodian and statistical acceptance that Turner and YSI are separate eras with no crosswalk.
student_explanation: The two sensor models produce very different numbers, so they cannot be combined into one series. Each era is analysed separately.

original_wording: (a) retain H, exclude C/E/G/O; (b) strict unflagged; (c) include all numeric
current_proposed_position: Adopt the addendum rule: exclude documented invalid flags; retain H only within a documented instrument range; negative RFU flagged below-baseline and sensitivity-only; Buffalo Pound >100 RFU excluded primary with sensitivity; undocumented flags unresolved and excluded primary; no imputation; no clean-data claim.
supporting_evidence: 4L.14 QC rules; independent review F-01/F-05 and QC audit; addendum F-01/F-05. Review found the 50% coverage rule arbitrary, negative/above-range RFU unresolved, and several flag/bound assumptions unsupported.
remaining_uncertainty: Instrument-specific range/flag meaning; whether 0–100 RFU is an operating range or display scale; B7 overlap with high biomass; negative RFU counts; undocumented flag semantics.
evidence_that_would_resolve: Provider/manufacturer documentation of flags and ranges; B7/negative counts from an authorised count-only audit; data-custodian sign-off on the analysis population.
student_explanation: This decides which sensor readings count as usable. We must not label questionable readings as clean or true just to increase the sample.

original_wording: (a) full-day mean for both lakes; (b) nighttime for BP only; (c) daytime for both
current_proposed_position: Adopt (a) full-day mean for both, with Buffalo Pound nighttime/daytime medians as sensitivity and an explicit statement that the two lakes’ daily summaries are not equivalent exposures.
supporting_evidence: 4L.9 Mendota daily means lack within-day counts; Buffalo Pound means computed from 10-minute data; addendum F-01/F-04; independent review F-01/F-04/F-05.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether a day’s mean represents the biological sample time/water parcel; Buffalo Pound date-specific coverage; diel quenching in Mendota cannot be removed.
specific_reviewers: Independent scientific reviewer + independent statistical reviewer
review_readiness: Conditional — after D-05 and coverage evidence
evidence_that_would_resolve: Date-specific coverage/representativeness documentation and reviewer acceptance of the asymmetric daily-summary statement.
student_explanation: We compare daily averages, but the two lakes’ averages are built differently. We must state that and test a Buffalo Pound night/day sensitivity.

original_wording: (a) same-day primary + ±1-day sensitivity; (b) ±3/±7/±14; (c) same-day only, no sensitivity
current_proposed_position: Adopt (a) revised: same-calendar-date primary; ±1 day exploratory only; no ±3/±7/±14; no lag/lead/onset.
supporting_evidence: 4L.13 matching review; addendum F-04/F-07. Biology is date-only; wider windows can span bloom phases and invite early-warning over-reading.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether ±1 day is worth reporting at all; it is exploratory only.
specific_reviewers: Independent scientific reviewer + independent statistical reviewer
evidence_that_would_resolve: Reviewer acceptance of same-date primary and exploratory-only ±1 day; decision whether to drop ±1.
student_explanation: Only measurements from the same calendar date count as the primary comparison. A one-day window is exploratory, not proof of synchrony.

original_wording: (a) mean before summing; (b) sum; (c) first row
current_proposed_position: Do not accept mean-before-sum as primary. Until the custodian documents whether duplicate date–species rows are technical replicates, split samples, subsamples, or distinct records, P3/P4 are exploratory only. If unresolved, exclude Buffalo Pound from primary analysis.
supporting_evidence: 4L.14 register; 4F audit; independent review F-02; addendum F-02. 2018 has 19 duplicate date–species groups without replicate IDs; 2019 has REP1/REP2 on disjoint dates.
remaining_uncertainty: What REP1/REP2 mean; whether duplicate rows are true replicates; whether mean/sum/first is scientifically correct.
evidence_that_would_resolve: Original data documentation or custodian statement defining replicate/subsample structure and the correct date-level aggregation.
student_explanation: If two rows are not repeat measurements, averaging them changes the total. We need the data owner to explain what the rows mean before choosing a rule.

original_wording: (a) retain and flag, exclude in sensitivity; (b) exclude from primary; (c) correct
current_proposed_position: Adopt (a): retain and flag primary; exclusion sensitivity; report rank extremeness and influence on rho; exact delta-rho; no correction; no bloom/non-bloom interpretation.
supporting_evidence: 4L.14 leverage plan; independent review F-12 and 2019 review; addendum F-12. The date has 45.81 mg/m3 total biomass, 41.02 cyanobacteria, all nine rows REP2; neighbours are much higher; cause unresolved.
remaining_uncertainty: Cause of the anomaly; whether the result depends on it; provenance of the REP2 rows.
review_readiness: Reviewable now with conditions — after D-05 principle
evidence_that_would_resolve: Reviewer acceptance of the retain/flag/influence plan; anomaly provenance if available (not required to decide handling).
student_explanation: One unusual date could dominate a small dataset. Keep it, flag it, and show how much the result changes without it — but do not “fix” it.

original_wording: (a) Mendota year-cluster bootstrap; BP naive date bootstrap + year separation; (b) p-values; (c) no intervals
current_proposed_position: Adopt revised (a): descriptive sensitivity ranges only. Mendota: rho, n, full leave-one-year-out set. Buffalo Pound: rho, n, separate 2018/2019, leave-one-date-out influence values. No bootstrap, percentiles, confidence interval, or p-values.
supporting_evidence: 4L.13 bootstrap/dependence review; 4L.14 uncertainty plan; independent review F-08; addendum F-08. Fourteen non-exchangeable years; two Buffalo Pound seasons; serial dependence.
remaining_uncertainty: No reliable interval for Buffalo Pound; Mendota leave-one-year-out is influence only, not sampling uncertainty.
evidence_that_would_resolve: Statistical sign-off on descriptive influence diagnostics and removal of the block bootstrap.
student_explanation: We report how much the result changes when years or dates are removed, not a fake confidence interval or p-value.

original_wording: (a) no stratum rho if n<10; show points; (b) compute all; (c) pool strata
current_proposed_position: Adopt (a) plus an overall estimability rule set by the statistical reviewer after the count audit and before estimation. If not met, show points only and return to review; no post hoc threshold.
supporting_evidence: 4L.14 register; independent review F-11 and statistical review; addendum F-11. Seasonal strata often 10–20; winter near zero; actual overall n unknown.
remaining_uncertainty: Actual n; exact overall minimum; whether any stratum is reportable.
review_readiness: Partly reviewable — principle now; numeric threshold after count audit
evidence_that_would_resolve: Count-only audit results and a pre-specified statistical estimability rule; no correlation required.
student_explanation: With very few points we show the data but do not report a correlation. The minimum must be set before seeing the result.

original_wording: (a) adopt as written; (b) soften prohibitions; (c) reject
current_proposed_position: Adopt (a) with addendum updates: rank association only; two case studies; no depth effect; no Pearson/log-Pearson; no validation, prediction, early warning, bloom, toxicity, whole-column, or agreement claims.
supporting_evidence: 4L.13/4L.14 claims review; addendum §6; independent review F-06/F-10/F-11. The study is a measurement audit, not EWS.
evidence_that_would_resolve: Scientific and Gate 2 sign-off on the updated permitted/prohibited claims.
student_explanation: This is the list of things we are not allowed to claim — especially validation, prediction, or early warning.

original_wording: (a) proceed as a modest measurement study; (b) pause; (c) pivot
current_proposed_position: Conditional (a): proceed as a modest exploratory measurement audit, with honest low–moderate originality. If the team requires a novel early-warning result, choose (b) pause. No pivot without a specific evidence-based alternative and new protocol.
supporting_evidence: Strategic reconstruction; 4L.14 independent review (originality low–moderate); Field Study Role Assessment; Option A/B/C comparison. Painter 2022 is direct prior art; field study is calibration, not EWS, and cannot finish for 2027.
remaining_uncertainty: Team goals and competition expectations; whether a modest/negative measurement audit is acceptable; whether Stage 2 data will arrive.
authority_category: Student/project owner decision (with scientific and Gate 2 concurrence)
specific_reviewers: Project owner + independent scientific reviewer + Gate 2 governance
review_readiness: Ready now — project-owner decision after addendum review
evidence_that_would_resolve: A documented project-owner decision with rationale, confirmed by scientific/Gate 2 review; competition expectations clarified.
student_explanation: Do we accept a modest, honest measurement study, or pause? This is mainly your call, but reviewers must confirm the choice is defensible.

original_wording: (a) use Painter data under CC BY-NC-SA with attribution/share-alike; (b) exclude Painter data; (c) seek permission
current_proposed_position: Adopt (a) only after a documented licence/competition review. If the competition cannot accommodate the licence, (b) exclude Buffalo Pound or (c) seek permission through the proper channel.
supporting_evidence: Painter data CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; official Creative Commons terms require attribution, non-commercial use, and share-alike for adaptations; SciFest 2027 rules; 4L.14 register D-14.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether competition display/report counts as non-commercial; share-alike obligations; whether permission is needed; exact venue/competition terms.
review_readiness: Ready for licence review — approval deferred
evidence_that_would_resolve: A written licence/competition review applying CC BY-NC-SA to the intended display/report, with attribution/share-alike plan; permission if required.
student_explanation: Can we display and share the Painter data under its licence? A licence reviewer must confirm before competition entry.

original_wording: (a) approve; (b) approve with changes; (c) do not approve
current_proposed_position: (c) Do not approve at this time. Reconsider only after D-01–D-14 are recorded, the addendum is re-reviewed, and the count-audit authorisation is separately defined.
supporting_evidence: 4L.14 register; addendum; strategic reconstruction. Actual n unknown; custodian/licence issues unresolved; no analysis authorised.
remaining_uncertainty: All preceding decisions; actual n; reviewer sign-offs; licence review.
specific_reviewers: All required approvers (scientific, statistical, data custodian, Gate 2, licence, project owner)
dependencies: D-01 through D-14; addendum review; count-audit authorisation
evidence_that_would_resolve: Recorded D-01–D-14, addendum re-review, separate count-audit authorisation, and explicit D-15 approval.
student_explanation: This is the final “start analysis” switch. It stays off until every other decision is recorded and the count audit has been separately authorised.
